nodes.label: Loam (Shell I)
nodes.rationale: The first shell and the teaching floor; currencies Dust/Brick/Ash/Loam/Marl. Owns the Face, Kiln, Drill Bay and the Lattice.

nodes.label: Ferrite (Shell II)
nodes.rationale: The shell-architecture proof; introduces the Breach, signatures and the Forge. Signature is Polarity.

nodes.label: Verdance (Shell III)
nodes.rationale: The shell where NOT acting is a strategy; signature is Growth.

nodes.label: Glassmere (Shell IV)
nodes.rationale: The purely spatial shell; signature is Refraction, a beam routed with mirrors.

nodes.label: Cinder (Shell V)
nodes.rationale: The game's first failure state and highest yields; signature is Pressure. Four laws keep flooding opt-in and non-permanent.

nodes.label: Hollow (Shell VI)
nodes.rationale: Absence: there is no rock; all income is the five carried signatures operating on emptiness. A hard check on Breach investment.

nodes.label: Aleph (Shell VII)
nodes.rationale: The endgame shell holding the Core, Recursion, Axioms, the Rewrite and Parallel View.

nodes.label: Polarity (signature)
nodes.rationale: Ferrite's signature: cells are + or -; chipping like-charged cells consecutively multiplies exponentially, breaking the chain penalizes. Clicking becomes a routing problem.

nodes.label: Growth (signature)
nodes.rationale: Verdance's signature: unmined cells sprout vines that generate passively and spread. Vines capture overflow regen, so they cannot beat the field ceiling (pillar 2).

nodes.label: Refraction (signature)
nodes.rationale: Glassmere's signature: a beam enters the face; mirrors route it; every cell it crosses is multiplied. Wavelength Split at Mastery 25 gives one rule per color.

nodes.label: Pressure (signature)
nodes.rationale: Cinder's signature: heat accumulates as you mine; unvented, the shaft floods and you lose the run. The Governor caps heat when vents are open, so flooding requires an explicit choke.

nodes.label: Absence (signature)
nodes.rationale: Hollow's signature: income is the sum of the carried signatures' voidTick over emptiness.

nodes.label: Signatures (carried mechanics)
nodes.rationale: Each shell's signature mechanic is permanently carried down, weakened, on Breach; by Shell VI the face runs five stacked mechanics at once. The payoff is qualitative, not a multiplier. Hooks compose multiplicatively; state hooks run carried-oldest-first, native mechanic last.

nodes.label: The Lattice
nodes.rationale: Loam's craft-system and the template for all others: a hex board of Motifs whose adjacency causes resonance; three same-shape in a line is a discovered Chord. Later Progressions read chords in placement order.

nodes.label: Alloy Crucible
nodes.rationale: Ferrite's craft-system: pour metals in ratios to get named alloys with rolled stats; valid ratios are a sparse discovered set. Verb is accumulation (slot three in, get three effects).

nodes.label: The Loom
nodes.rationale: Verdance's craft-system: assign thread types to warp rows and weft columns; effects come from emergent tetromino-like shapes in the intersection grid.

nodes.label: Refraction Bench
nodes.rationale: Glassmere's craft-system: place optics to route a beam through targets; every solved config is saved as an equippable Lens. 50 authored puzzles plus a constructive generator.

nodes.label: Ember Array
nodes.rationale: Cinder's craft-system: a real-time furnace grid where fire spreads as fuel dies; sustaining a target temperature band is a permanent record. Engaged play is about 2x passive by arithmetic.

nodes.label: Echo Chamber
nodes.rationale: Hollow's craft-system and the deepest in the game: record your own dispatches and replay them through the REAL engine, so a program obeys every ceiling a hand does. A programming language for your own automation.

nodes.label: Axiom Solitaire
nodes.rationale: Aleph's craft-system: a run-based card game whose deck is built from your owned upgrades, feeding Axiom Fragments.

nodes.label: Collapse (reset layer 1)
nodes.rationale: Any-time reset of face upgrades, shell currencies and depth in exchange for Cores. Cores = floor(2*(Depth/40)^1.5).

nodes.label: Breach (reset layer 2)
nodes.rationale: The emotional core: reaching a shell floor resets Cores and shell systems but permanently carries that shell's signature mechanic and grants Echoes.

nodes.label: Recursion (reset layer 3)
nodes.rationale: Reaching the Core of the World resets all shells and Echoes but not you, handing you Axioms. Tools survive as heirlooms blunted to Shell I.

nodes.label: Spiral (reset layer 4)
nodes.rationale: The post-Recursion endgame layer: resets Axioms for Spiral currency, unlocking challenges, parallel shells and the Automation Grid.

nodes.label: Echoes
nodes.rationale: Earned on Breach; in the Interlock phase they also buy confluence slots. Echoes = floor(3*(CoresEarnedThisBreach/500)^0.6).

nodes.label: Axioms
nodes.rationale: ~20 rule-rewrites, each of which changes a RULE of the engine rather than a number, composing through a typed law registry. Exactly one heresy touches pillar 2 and announces it.

nodes.label: Pillar 1: Idle-able AND interactive
nodes.rationale: Idle is always viable; active play is ~5x idle at the start, converging to ~1.3x by mid-game, and matters most when the player has least.

nodes.label: Pillar 2: Field regen is the hard ceiling on income
nodes.rationale: Drills can only harvest what the field produces (DPS_max = W*H*regen*Y). This is what makes uncapped offline progress mathematically safe and forces engagement with external multiplier systems.
nodes.norm_label: pillar 2: field regen is the hard ceiling on income

nodes.label: Pillar 3: No offline cap, ever
nodes.rationale: Production is rate-limited, not exponential. offlineEfficiency = 0.55 + 0.03*Persistence, cap 0.95 (1.00 via Axiom); depth does not advance offline until Auto-Descend.

nodes.label: Pillar 4: Craft-systems never mandatory grinds
nodes.rationale: Each craft-system has a Passive Rank giving ~50% of engaged play; they gate specific unlocks, not just multipliers. Player goes in, finds the 3 things they need, leaves.

nodes.label: Pillar 5: Discovery over unlocking
nodes.rationale: Chords, alloys, weaves, brews, Bench answers and Figures are found by experimenting; the Codex fills in as you find them; never show a locked list. Enforced mechanically by compendium-coverage which fails on a discovery answer leaking into text.

nodes.label: Pillar 6: Return to prior peak in <=20-25% of the time
nodes.norm_label: pillar 6: return to prior peak in <=20-25% of the time

nodes.label: Pillar 7: New system every 10-15 min for the first 3 hours
nodes.rationale: No upgrade takes more than ~6 min to afford at its intended stage.
nodes.norm_label: pillar 7: new system every 10-15 min for the first 3 hours

nodes.label: Pillar 8: The engine is headless
nodes.rationale: Pure TS, no React/Pixi/DOM knowledge; the UI is a dumb renderer over tick/getState/dispatch/subscribe. Non-negotiable: it is what allows 40 systems to coexist.

nodes.label: The curriculum law (head gates the tier)
nodes.rationale: A tool's head material decides the hardest wall it can break; each tier needs materials from the current shell AND one shell above, forcing older shells to stay alive. Haft and binding are free.
nodes.norm_label: the curriculum law (head gates the tier)

nodes.label: The Export Spine
nodes.rationale: The A.39 Interlock fix for a hollow middle band ('nothing needs anything else'): one export per shell, made by that shell's own craft and demanded by the next shell's signature infrastructure, Loam->Aleph. Gates but can never softlock because Serra's Export Shelf backstops it.

nodes.label: Serra's Export Shelf
nodes.rationale: A deterministic, never-rotated stall at the Guild selling every left-behind shell's export, so the export spine gates progress but can never softlock; enforced by an export-graph audit.

nodes.label: Confluences (the confluence layer)
nodes.rationale: Things that only happen when two systems are true at once, held as 16 data entries. Three safety rules, each test-enforced: a bonus for having both never a requirement; discovered not announced; it pays only while it holds.

nodes.label: Kilnflux (Loam export)
nodes.rationale: Loam's export, made by the Refinery chain 'The Kiln Firing' from a true-orphan input plus marl; consumed by every Crucible pour, hit or miss.

nodes.label: Lodeframe (Ferrite export)
nodes.rationale: Ferrite's export, produced at the Crucible from Scale + Lodestone; builds Verdance's Greenhouse beds past four and braces the Loom's iron frame.

nodes.label: Set Resin (Verdance export)
nodes.rationale: Verdance's export, rendered at the Still from Sap + Resin; silvers every Glassmere mirror past the fourth.

nodes.label: Fibercloth (Verdance export)
nodes.rationale: Verdance's second export, yielded by every committed Loom weave; wraps Observatory exposure lenses (the 10-min glance stays free).

nodes.label: Ground Lens (Glassmere export)
nodes.rationale: Glassmere's export, produced at the Bench from Silica + Prism; sockets the Ember Array's rows past the first, one lens per row.

nodes.label: Glasseal (Glassmere export)
nodes.rationale: Glassmere's second export, produced at the Bench from Silica + Rime; joins Cinder's deep vent pipe sections 13-24.

nodes.label: Emberglass (Cinder export)
nodes.rationale: Cinder's export, annealed by holding a LIVE Ember Array in-band; rebuilds the Hollow past eight cells and arms every Echo Chamber recording ('the tape is cut in glass').

nodes.label: Delver XP
nodes.rationale: One of four progression spines: all actions grant XP; never resets, not even on Recursion. xpToLevel(L) = 100*L^1.9, cap L200.

nodes.label: Delver Skill Tree
nodes.rationale: Three branches (Extraction / Industry / Insight) with free respec; ~200 pts to max so builds diverge.

nodes.label: Shell Mastery
nodes.rationale: Per-shell level 1-50 from depth records only; gates that shell's advanced systems; never resets.

nodes.label: Tool Tiers (I-XV)
nodes.rationale: Tools hard-gate cell hardness; each tier needs materials from the current shell and one above.

nodes.label: The Face
nodes.rationale: The mining grid of charged cells you chip; refills from below. Later gained HOLD-to-chip, MARK cells drills route around, a stamina-costed SWEEP, and FIGURES (shapes cut into rock that pay XP+drops+stamina, never Dust, kept in a pillar-5 Codex).

nodes.label: The Kiln
nodes.rationale: Dust->Brick converter, throughput-limited with its own fuel curve; later gained FUEL profiles (a trade, not a ladder), an opt-in OVERSTOKE burst and banked heat.

nodes.label: Drill Bay
nodes.rationale: Up to 24 drills, each with a targeting behavior; later gained named, breakable-and-repairable drills that WEAR and never die, configured by swappable HEADS and material BITS.

nodes.label: The Forge
nodes.rationale: Where tool tiers, hardness gating and tool affixes live. In the Interlock plan the Forge pulls the Refinery, Crucible and Still through it.

nodes.label: Magnet Array
nodes.rationale: A Ferrite placement puzzle over the face that pre-arranges polarity.

nodes.label: The Greenhouse
nodes.rationale: Verdance strain-breeding: 12 strains crossed on a form/humor grammar to 78 hybrids.

nodes.label: Mycelium Network
nodes.rationale: A spreading node graph; connected nodes share bonuses, fed self-spread, survives everything.

nodes.label: The Still
nodes.rationale: Verdance distillery of ratio-found brews (12 spikes); also renders Set Resin in the export spine.

nodes.label: The Observatory
nodes.rationale: Glassmere game-clock exposures returning Spectrum and eight constellations (AFK).

nodes.label: Wavelength Split
nodes.rationale: Late-Glassmere: at Mastery 25 the beam splits into colors, one rule per color.

nodes.label: Vent Network
nodes.rationale: Cinder pipe-routing layer built once and tuned constantly; open vents cap heat (the Governor).

nodes.label: Magma Wells
nodes.rationale: Commit <=10% currency with odds posted at the mouth; EV 1.17, results wait forever.

nodes.label: The Silence
nodes.rationale: A Hollow stacking debuff you manage rather than remove; managing it well IS the income source (farm entropy).

nodes.label: Reconstruction
nodes.rationale: Rebuild a phantom Hollow face from Void one cell at a time, with real ceilings; pillar 2 binds.

nodes.label: The Rewrite
nodes.rationale: Aleph mechanism: spend Axioms to alter generation rules permanently.

nodes.label: Parallel View
nodes.rationale: Aleph: all six shells above shown live and running on one screen.

nodes.label: The Core of the World
nodes.rationale: Reaching it triggers Recursion; Sable's journals slowly reveal what it is and why the world is built in layers.

nodes.label: The Refinery
nodes.rationale: The smithing chain between a material in the Hold and a tool in your hand; the home of transmutation. Built because a material-audit found 49 of 132 materials had zero consumers.

nodes.label: Tempering
nodes.rationale: A smithing verb of CONDITION: pays when your situation matches, idles otherwise; deliberately distinct from runes, alloys and transmutation. Later resonates with the tool's own shell affinity.

nodes.label: Transmutation
nodes.rationale: A SET verb: two inputs, order-independent, deliberately NOT the positional rune wall. A test asserts every chain consumes a material that previously had no consumer.

nodes.label: Rune Inscription
nodes.rationale: A positional grammar where adjacent runes interact (order IS meaning); bad sequences ruin the inscription, never the piece. Amended at Phase 8: 'keep the stakes, remove the trap' (recorded in A.17).

nodes.label: The Warrens
nodes.rationale: Optional hand-built side-tunnels: fixed layout, a puzzle, a fight and a guaranteed unique; ~20 built.

nodes.label: Brewing
nodes.rationale: Alchemy from Sap, Spore, Resin into timed consumables (Longlight, Ironblood, Sable's Draught); recipes discovered by experimenting.

nodes.label: The Museum
nodes.rationale: Display relics, gems and bestiary trophies in camp; completed cases give permanent global bonuses.

nodes.label: The Guild (the Lamphouse)
nodes.rationale: The surface hub of ~30 named NPCs with schedules, moods and clock-rotating stock; reputation unlocks recipes, discounts and questlines.

nodes.label: Sable (the story)
nodes.rationale: Went ahead of you and left journals at depth, found out of order and less coherent the deeper you go; delivered in fragments while mining, never cutscenes.

nodes.label: Contracts Board
nodes.rationale: State-generated NPC jobs that stack with what you were already doing; pays Scrip, Renown, recipes.

nodes.label: Hirelings
nodes.rationale: Recruited NPCs who run drills, auto-sell, auto-craft or fight; they level and can die permanently in Cinder (deterministic, named in advance, always recallable).

nodes.label: The Caravan (Serra)
nodes.rationale: Trade currencies between shells at rates drifting on a real clock; rewards checking in, never punishes not checking in. Serra also runs the Export Shelf.

nodes.label: Relics
nodes.rationale: ~80 rolled-affix relics, Common to Mythic, fusable, 6 slots.

nodes.label: The Foundry
nodes.rationale: Permanent modules in a limited Echo-gated slot grid (3->12); modules conflict and synergize (~70 modules).

nodes.label: Expeditions
nodes.rationale: Send crews into side tunnels for 2 min - 8 hrs of pure AFK, returning currency bundles and relics; can set off from depth.

nodes.label: The Shaft
nodes.rationale: Climb back up your own carved column on a rail laid with Cores that outlives the Collapse; rendered as a procedural chunk-baked Pixi pixel-cave whose silhouette grammar diverges per shell.

nodes.label: Curing
nodes.rationale: Turns real time into an ingredient: a stone left at depth becomes something better.

nodes.label: Excavation
nodes.rationale: Hand-built excavations in the column, cleared a shift at a time per visit.

nodes.label: The Unmineable Wall
nodes.rationale: One unmineable wall per shell that reads you back and carries Sable's marks.

nodes.label: The Assay Table
nodes.rationale: Pre-identify what a vein contains before committing time; its cost is time and Insight, not wear (tool durability was cut in Phase 2 as anti-idle and anti-pillar-1).

nodes.label: The Compendium
nodes.rationale: An in-game wiki generated from the registries (~353 entries, only 39 hand-written) so it cannot drift from the game; explains mechanics and never solutions (pillar 5), enforced by compendium-coverage.

nodes.label: The Codex
nodes.rationale: ~250 discoveries across all craft-systems, the longest tail in the game; fills in as you find things (pillar 5).

nodes.label: Achievements
nodes.rationale: 250 in a 25x10 grid, each a real bonus; completing a full row or column gives a large one; grid completion is an endgame goal.

nodes.label: Material Traits (materials with souls)
nodes.rationale: Every material carries 2-3 of ten traits (Keen, Tough, Dense, Light, Springy, Brittle, Charged, Warm, Hollow, Trueseated) to make it a character not a tier. Traits are the one place pillar 5 does not apply (visible everywhere); their pair combinations are discovered.

nodes.label: Tools From Parts (head/haft/binding)
nodes.rationale: A tool is a HEAD, HAFT and BINDING, each a material reading different traits; the archetype emerges from composition, so variants are not authored and the ladder cannot go lopsided. Reversed the Phase 16 cut of tool-variants because composition gives every tier choice for free.

nodes.label: Gems
nodes.rationale: Six gems socketed rather than smelted; geodes are unidentified until cracked; gem cutting and fusion shipped in the Workbench.

nodes.label: Ore Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: 139 materials across 6 rarity tiers with rolled purity that carries into anything crafted; WORKED materials are made, never found, and filtered out of drops.

nodes.label: The Deepwrought
nodes.rationale: Things that live in the shells; combat is turn-based-with-timing on a small lane grid. They drop materials that cannot be mined.

nodes.label: Floor Wardens
nodes.rationale: A boss guarding each Breach (e.g. the Tapmother, the Loadstar); the spec requires the warden->breach->ferrite arc to work on pure auto.

nodes.label: The Modifier Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Every bonus is a named source registered into a typed bucket (17 members); systems read the bucket product and breakdown() shows the player where a number comes from. If it isn't in a bucket it doesn't exist. Bucket names are a closed union so a wrong name is a compile error.

nodes.label: THE HOLLOW app shell (index.html)
nodes.rationale: The static shell: a dark-themed page mounting #root and loading /src/main.tsx as a module; the dumb renderer entry point over the headless engine.
